test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To tell the nature of a disease by its symptoms.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. **"Diagnosis".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Diagnosis:** (निदान) - The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

 
 
• **Example: **The patient received an accurate diagnosis after the examination.
 
 
 
• To tell the nature
